capabilities: Chat with a model about attached notes, selections, folders and attachments
Propose edits as diffs approved hunk by hunk, inline or in the sidebar
Run built-in presets for proofreading, garden-path sentences and fact-checking
Ask permission before reading extra notes or fetching web pages
Log accepted AI edits per note with undo and redo
extras: Desktop only, Obsidian 1.15.1 or later; AGPL-3.0-or-later; no telemetry or update checks; API keys kept in Obsidian's secret storage; chats and settings stored in the plugin folder inside the vault's configuration folder.
problem: Using an LLM on notes usually means copying text out of the vault and pasting edits back, with no control over what the model reads or which changes land.

relations.evidence: Lektor's design drew on two MIT-licensed Obsidian plugins: LLM Hub
Smart Composer (reviewing proposed edits block by block)

summary: Sidebar chat that works on your writing with a local or CLI language model, showing every proposed edit as a diff you approve hunk by hunk.
